title: Pontotoc Nights set for Oct. 24 at First Choice Gateway Pavilion

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Nights is scheduled for Saturday, Oct. 24, from 2 to 8 p.m. at First Choice Gateway Pavilion in Pontotoc, according to Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street’s October calendar.
Vendor announcements shared by the Chamber name Fairy Floss Cotton Candy, Just Bead It Up, Gabbs of Love Candle Co. and Buck Horn Staffs.
For additional information, the Chamber lists 662-489-5042 and chamber@pontotocchamber.com.
